newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary cenbank cuts 1yr bond yield to 20.03 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cenbank cuts 1yr bond yield to 20.03 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) reduced the yield of its one-year bonds to 20.03 percent from 20.27 percent on Monday, the NBH said on its NBHJ page.
Analysts said earlier that the yield on the new one-year NBH bonds, first issued in June, served as a support for the yields on 12-month Treasury bills and also influenced other yields.
Earlier on Monday, the NBH cut four of its five repo rates by 25 basis points.
